messages:
zoe: Quick design check — QA flagged focus loss when switching expanded rules in the editor on mobile widths. need a small UX decision.

nick: Reproced. Two options: keep multiple open (stacked scroll) or single-open accordion. Keyboard focus is easier with single-open.

ara: I vote single-open. Less layout shift and we can announce open/close to screen readers.

dena: Agree. If single-open, add an "Open all" action in header for power users. Also make the expand control a real button with text Show details / Hide details (not icon-only).

zoe: Good. For SR announce use aria-live polite: "Rule X expanded". Keep it short.

nick: For reorder, change the handle to a button aria-label="Move rule" and add a three-dot menu with Move up / Move down actions for touch. Mention keyboard shortcuts in the tooltip (Alt+Up/Down).

ara: Copy tweak for priority errors: replace "Invalid priority" with "Priority conflict: two rules share the same priority. Reorder or change the number." more actionable.

dena: Also suggestion for simulation playback: announce progress via aria-live polite "Simulation: 2 of 12 events matched" and a final polite summary by default, with an "Announce results" button that uses assertive if user requests.

sim-bot: Simulation queued label="single-open-ux-check" 20 runs across widths [360, 768, 1200].

nick: Dev notes: postpone programmatic focus until after transitionend or keep focus on the trigger (preferred). Add unit test asserting trigger remains document.activeElement after opening next card.

zoe: Cool. If sim passes we'll include in patch cut. tiny PR ok.

sim-bot: Simulation complete — 20 runs, 1 failure at 360 where focus jumped to body. Log: "focusAfterOpen != trigger".

ara: I'll take the fix (defer focus + aria-live). Will ping when green.

zoe: Thanks! :sparkles:
